title: The Loud Risk and the Quiet One: Typhoon Dujuan, the Super El Niño and Japan's Power Coast
detail: Typhoon Dujuan broke Tokyo's rainfall records. For the power plants that ring Tokyo Bay, our engine finds the bigger financial exposure is not the storm.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
